description: From XP's connected resale order book. Two-phase write on the XP live offer book. Use when an authenticated seller wants to reject a specific bid on their tickets to a listing (e.g. 'reject the lowball offer on my tickets'). Call with `confirm=False` first to preview which offer will be rejected; call with `confirm=True` only after the user explicitly approves. Do not use without the two-phase preview-then-confirm flow. Only confirm=True submissions return success=true. Requires auth and write:listings scope. Seller-facing: you are rejecting a buyer's offer on your own listing.

confirm.description: Required. True to reject the offer; False to preview without rejecting.

identifier.description: Public listing identifier from list_my_listings or get_my_listing_status.

name: reject_offer
title: Reject Offer
